title: ActionIntent
description: An operation an AI agent is preparing to perform, normalised by an adapter before policy evaluation. Adapters observe different things — an MCP tool call, a shell command, a cloud API call — and all of them produce this shape so policy is written once. Provider specifics live under action.provider/action.name; no provider is part of the generic structure.

id.description: Stable identifier for this intent. Referenced by the Decision and the EvidenceEvent so the three can be correlated after the fact.

version.description: The agent's own release string, when it reports one. Attested by the agent, never measured.

actor.description: Who the agent is acting for. 'unattended' is a real answer and MUST be distinguishable from an absent actor: a scheduled agent genuinely has no human behind it, and treating silence as autonomy is a different claim from recording it.

type.description: Open vocabulary. Known values are listed as examples, not enforced, so a new adapter does not require a schema change.

arguments.description: Tool or command arguments. MUST be redacted before persistence — see redaction requirements. Never store raw secret values here.

context.description: Evaluation context. Values supplied by the caller are ATTESTED, not measured: they may escalate a decision but must never weaken one, or the cheapest bypass is to claim to be safe.
